run.rubric_summary: Score = company size (max 2.5) + industry fit (max 2.0) + intent signal from lead source (max 3.5) + recency of last interaction (max 2.0) = 10. >= 7.0 qualified, 6.0-7.0 human review, < 6.0 rejected. Micro companies (<=10 staff), very large companies (>20,000 staff) and contacts older than a year are capped at review.

common_rejection_reasons: Weak buying-intent signal (cold or early-stage source)
review_reasons: score in 'too close to call' band
knock-out cap (Company has 10 or fewer employees)

efficiency.note: Manual estimate assumes 10 min per lead (brief: 8-12 min).
